style: Icon-first accent piece. One clean, abstract, hand-drawn line-art chat-bubble icon as the hero visual — the icon IS the message, minimal text. Purple/black brand system matching shared-lead-problem and demand-reputation-flywheel: dark radial bg, accent-purple line art, soft glow blooms, League Gothic for any display type, Montserrat for the small payoff label. Calm draw-on entrance, a lively typing beat, a quick AI sparkle accent, then a punchy short hold.

customize.note: No exact-fit catalog block for a custom minimal-line chat-bubble hero icon; searched catalog first (queries below) and reused named PRIMITIVES + one reference pattern instead of a full block, per reuse-first with hand-author-for-gaps.
catalog_searches_run: chat bubble icon line art draw in
sparkle star pop glow AI icon

catalog_findings.typing-indicator (component): three-dot chat-bubble typing UI — inspiration for the stagger/pulse rhythm, but it renders its own bubble chrome so it doesn't fit inside our custom drawn bubble; motion pattern reused, markup hand-authored
catalog_findings.svg-line-draw-loader / hw-text-cloud: confirm stroke-dashoffset draw-on is the right family for the bubble outline; hand-authored directly per the shared-lead-problem reference (#connector-svg path pattern: pathLength=1, strokeDasharray:1, strokeDashoffset 1→0)
catalog_findings.sparkle/star pop-glow: no matching catalog item; hand-authored from motion-vocabulary primitives scale_punch (back.out) + glow (yoyo textShadow/filter)

content.logo: inline-svg:hand-drawn-chat-bubble-icon (self-authored line art, not a sourced asset)
scene_notes: Beat 1 (0.0-1.0s): #bg-fill fades in once (never fades out — no blank-frame gap). Chat-bubble outline draws on via stroke-dashoffset + scales in slightly, centered, accent-purple (#9B5CFF) line art on transparent/dark ground.
Beat 2 (1.0-2.5s): 3 typing dots inside the bubble animate in sequence, staggered pulse/bounce, looped ~2x within the window, suggesting a live conversation.
Beat 3 (2.5-3.2s): small sparkle/star glyph pops in near the top-right of the bubble with a quick scale_punch + glow flash, signaling AI.
Beat 4 (3.2-4.5s): short label 'ALWAYS ANSWERING.' fades up beneath the icon (Montserrat, bold, uppercase, letter-spaced, --text color) and holds.
Beat 5 (4.5-5.0s): freeze-hold, nothing new animates, clean cut point.
